contents: the tempo-distribution prior: the feature constants (mel filterbank, DCT rows, bin log-frequencies, sharpness weights, level groups, contrast octaves, modulation band-pass filters, loudness weighting, tonal, key and chord templates), the statistics bank layout and coefficients, the used-feature map and row schedule, the kn tree model, its calibration and the log-tempo prior grid; only the tree model and its calibration are fitted, the rest is derived or specified
model_kind: CatBoost multi-class classifier that scores the song tempo on 27 log-tempo classes (1/8 octave apart) from running statistics of spectral, temporal, tonal and beat-activation features; one prior row per second since the last reset
runtime_decision: Compiled into the DSP module and evaluated once per second after a reset; the calibrated class probabilities become a log-tempo prior for the decoder. The weights are fixed at build time.

fitted_values.values: tree model (327 oblivious trees of depth 4)
fitted_values.fitted_on: the training data below; the iteration count is the median of the early-stopping optima of five cross-validation folds

fitted_values.values: calibration temperature and floor (P = (1 - lam) softmax(ln max(p, 1e-12) / T) + lam / 27)
fitted_values.fitted_on: out-of-fold predictions of the same cross-validation, the proprietary group and the GiantSteps group weighted equally

derived_or_specified: the feature constants are computed from their published definitions (mel scale, DCT-II, Zwicker sharpness weighting, approximate K-weighting, Krumhansl-Kessler key profiles, triad templates) at the stated parameters; the statistics windows, loudness histogram edges, autocorrelation windows and the 1 s row period are specified

training_parameters.row_weights: every training track carries the same total weight

training_data.labels: the song tempo at the tactus level; GiantSteps tracks use the crowd-sourced tempo annotations weighted by their vote shares

storage.policy: Splits and tree order are unchanged. Leaves are rounded to binary16; against the source model the largest log-probability change is below 1e-3 with no change of the most likely class.
